text: hey so look here [Image #3] i cant walk under this floor but i can under the ramp :? wat
resolution: Investigated 'can't walk under this floor but can under the ramp'. Baked the user's real map and read every floor collider band: floors are banded correctly (each storey floor blocks only at its own height — [3.0,3.2],[6.0,6.2],[9.0,9.2]...), player collision capsule is 1.65m (~1.75m head). So it is NOT a collision bug — it is clearance/collider-type: a floor is a solid banded rect (blocks when your head reaches its underside), while a ramp is a heightfield (only supports from above, never side-blocks), so a ramp is always passable underneath. The map had floor/platform pieces low enough (<1.8m underside) that a 1.75m player can't fit under — same as /test. Surfaced the behavior + offered a one-way-platform option; user ruled floors can't be placed that low anyway so it's a non-issue. No code change. Leaving floor collision solid (parity with /test).
